output.reason: The brief's account fits what I've seen: the errors hit only the premium line, the CR-118 change on 22 Oct was approved untested as a "label fix", and it cites an append-only audit trail and an internal-audit re-run, so the actions are clear; I'm marking correctness down slightly because some details don't match my evidence (147 underpaid vs 139 complainants, 22 flagged staff vs Ardentra's 18 flagged complainants, and it calls Malcolm's proposal Ardentra's).
